title: Ngọn nến cuối
about: A replacement for k58 (The Last Candle, album 7), which drew a YouTube Content ID match: k58's C minor i-VI-iv-V on strings and a felt piano is common ground. Here B minor on a less usual progression (with Lydian colour), a music box improvising, then the solo string, strings, pad, a far choir. Sleep style (ngu-ngon). k58 is left as it was. An original piece.
